script.title: NO GLASSES, PLEASE
script.scene_zh: 藥局拍照台 · 拍護照大頭照
script.story_hook: One grumpy snapshot turns into a good day.
script.intro_zh: 一張兇兇的照片，變成今天最開心的小事。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we take passport photos. Listen for photo rules and fixes.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們去拍護照大頭照。留意說規則與修正的對話。
script.outro: Smile saved, plans set. Bye for now!
script.outro_zh: 笑容拍好了，行程就緒了。再見囉！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each photo counter phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，逐句跟讀拍照櫃台的常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her late twenties with chin-length wavy hair dyed teal at the ends, wearing a denim jacket over a white tee, black ankle jeans and red canvas shoes, small hoop earrings, bright-eyed and cheerful
script.char_b_description: a teenage boy of nineteen with neat black bowl-cut hair and a clean-shaven face, wearing a store green apron over a plain gray tee, dark chinos and clean white sneakers, slim build and eager

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need passport photos today.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我今天要拍護照照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You came to the right place. Two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kemeɪ tə ðə ɹaɪt pleɪs tu ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 你來對地方了。兩塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dollars? Online it's thirty.
dialogue.zh: 兩塊？線上申請一個要三十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, we beat the internet. Ready to start?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wi bit ði ˈɪntɚˌnɛt ˈɹɛdi tə staɹt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我們比網路價便宜。可以開始了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. Do I take off my glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs du aɪ teɪk ɔf maɪ ˈɡlæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 好，我要先摘掉眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No glasses, no hats. Rules, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɡlæsəz noʊ hæts ɹulz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 眼鏡、帽子都不行。規定嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Off they go. How's this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɔf ðeɪ ɡoʊ haʊz ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 懂了，都摘下來。這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Now face the gray backdrop.
dialogue.zh: 很好，請對著灰色背景站好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Staring like a deer?
dialogue.zh: 這樣？瞪得像受驚的小鹿嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly like a deer. But softer, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk ə dɪɹ bʌt ˈsɔfɚ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 就是那樣。不過請柔和一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Softer. Okay. Like thinking of soup?
dialogue.zh: 柔和。嗯，像想著一碗湯那樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Perfect. Hold that. Flash coming.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！完美，保持這個。要閃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it work? My ears are still ringing.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt wɜɹk maɪ ɪɹz ɑɹ stɪl ˈɹɪŋɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 拍進去了嗎？我耳朵還有點嗡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second, printing your strip now.
dialogue.zh: 稍等，我現在幫你印照片條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A strip? How many photos do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɹɪp haʊ ˈmɛnɪ ˈfoʊtoʊz du aɪ ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 一條？我可以拿到幾張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight in a row. Keep the extra ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪn ə ɹoʊ kip ði ˈɛkstɹə wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 一排八張。多出來的留著用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight? That's a lot of me.
dialogue.zh: 八張？有八個我耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Here you go. Warm and shiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ wɔɹm ænd ˈʃaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！給，熱騰騰亮晶晶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh wow. That's... not my good side.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ waʊ ðæts nɑt maɪ ɡʊd saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 噢哇。這張……不是我好看的那面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone hates their first photos.
dialogue.zh: 大家都嫌自己的第一版照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my hair doing the thing again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ hɛɹ ˈduɪŋ ðə θɪŋ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮又在搗亂了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's sweet. It adds character, truly.
dialogue.zh: 它很可愛，說真的，還很有性格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll keep this frown as brand.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn aɪl kip ðɪs fɹaʊn æz brænd/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我就把這表情當招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Please don't. Retake? On the house.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ pliz doʊnt ˈɹiˌteɪk ɑn ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，千萬別。要重拍嗎？免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? You're joking, right?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你在開玩笑吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dead serious. Smile for round two.
dialogue.zh: 非常認真。第二回合，笑一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... there? Did that look normal?
dialogue.zh: 好……這樣呢？看起來正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me peek. Well, that's better!
dialogue.zh: 讓我瞄一下。嗯，這張好多了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister said I smile with eyes closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstɚ sɛd aɪ smaɪl wɪð aɪz kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 我姊說我笑的時候眼睛閉著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours are open. Look, tiny dimple.
dialogue.zh: 你的睜開了。看，還有小酒窩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dimple? Nobody ever noticed that.
dialogue.zh: 酒窩？我都不知道我有酒窩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the passport will know. Want a retake?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈpæspɔɹt wɪl noʊ wɑnt ə ˈɹiˌteɪk/
dialogue.zh: 護照現在知道囉。要不要再來一輪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, this one's perfect. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 不用，這張很完美。謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need the printed form today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid ði ˈpɹɪntɪd fɔɹm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你今天需要列印申請表嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, you can print forms too?
dialogue.zh: 等等，你們也能列印表格？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every size. Which application do you need?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi saɪz wɪtʃ ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən du ju nid/
dialogue.zh: 各種尺寸都有。你要哪份申請表？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The renewal one. Mine expires in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɹɪˈnjuəl̩ wʌn maɪn ɪkˈspaɪɚz ɪn mɑɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 補換發那張。我的三月到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It prints right here. Fill the box in blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɹɪnts ɹaɪt hɪɹ fɪl ðə bɑks ɪn blu/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡印。請用藍色筆填寫方格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue only? My pen is black.
dialogue.zh: 只能用藍色筆嗎？我這支是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, a free blue pen. On the house again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ə fri blu pɛn ɑn ðə haʊs əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 給您一支免費藍筆，又請客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're giving away everything today.
dialogue.zh: 你今天什麼都白送耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We sell photos, not kindness. Ha!
dialogue.zh: 我們賣照片，不賣善良。哈哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll remember that line.
dialogue.zh: 我會記得這一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now sign at the bottom, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ saɪn æt ðə ˈbɑtəm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請在最下面簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small print says... no staples here.
dialogue.zh: 小字寫著，這裡別用釘書機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the consulate hates staples.
dialogue.zh: 對，使館最討厭釘書針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I just stapled page two.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ aɪ dʒʌst ˈsteɪpəld peɪdʒ tu/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我剛把第二頁釘起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Relax, I'll un-staple it fast.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！別慌，我兩下就拆掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver. Truly.
dialogue.zh: 你真的幫了大忙。說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my job. Here, smooth and staple-free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ dʒɑb hɪɹ smuð ænd ˈsteɪpəl̩ˈfɹi/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。給，平平的，沒有釘書針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take the photo digitally too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈdɪdʒuəli tu/
dialogue.zh: 數位檔可以給我一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one email, done. What's your address?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈimeɪl dʌn wʌts jʊɹ əˈdɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 好，一封郵件就好。你的信箱是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dot-com classic, I'm afraid.
dialogue.zh: 希望你別笑，是很老的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've mailed grandmas. It's fine. Sent.
dialogue.zh: 我也幫阿嬤收過信。沒關係，已經送出了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're official now, passport me.
dialogue.zh: 現在的我有護照大頭照囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looking travel-ready. Where to first?
dialogue.zh: 看起來隨時可以出發，第一想去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Japan! I've saved for two years.
dialogue.zh: 日本！我存了兩年的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take ten photos, not eight.
dialogue.zh: 那你要帶十張走，不是八張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! I'll take the whole strip home.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl teɪk ðə hoʊl stɹɪp hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，整條我都帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe travels! Mind the dimple, smile wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ˈtɹævəlz maɪnd ðə ˈdɪmpəl̩ smaɪl waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 一路順風！記得你的酒窩，多笑一點。

script.youtube_description:
60句護照照片聽力練習：拍大頭照不能戴眼鏡？拍醜了能免費重來嗎？申請表哪裡印？

這一集跟著一位即將飛日本的旅客，在藥局拍照台從摘眼鏡、對背景、讓閃光嚇一跳，一路聽到照片條幾張、免費重拍的說法、藍色筆填表、釘書機小意外，還有數位檔怎麼寄。

你會聽到：
- 拍照規則與穿著限制的短句
- 要求重拍與問價格的說法
- 列印表格、填表須知的對話
- 移除釘書機與寄檔的應變

You will hear how to ask about sizes, copies, and digital files, then review every line with shadowing practice in the second half.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.
